title: I’ve been building a Sekiro-style top down HD-2D action RPG set in Sengoku Japan, using Claude Code for a lot of the dev work
author: Icy-Drop-9535

comments.author: Aznshorty13
comments.body:
Those are clean sounds! What did you use?

Also do you generate images, or have them draw, or is it 3d?

Good stuff man.

replies.author: Icy-Drop-9535
replies.body: Thank you brother! I'm a sound designer by profession, I made those in Cubase (placeholders for now), heavily inspired by Sekiro, so glad you liked them! The 3D assets were bought or downloaded for free, and I drew the pixel art myself... pixel art one love 🫠
